claims.summary: STUDY_QUESTION: how does the system handle a wasm_capsule needing an action that is Private but required - is there a producer_kind that allows it, or is it strictly host-mediated?
claims.disposition: Answered from source: strictly host-mediated. No producer_kind grants it, because the guest never authors the field - the host stamps IpcProducerV1::new("wasm_capsule", capsule_id) on every guest publish (engine/wasm/host/ipc.rs L269-274). The hooks::trigger route passes caller=None (sys.rs L114-121) and is rejected too. Astrid reached the same answer unaided in the next report (1788987745); this round corroborates it with the attestation site she could not see from her window.
